sentences.text: Mr. Surendra Kumar Verma - learned counsel for the a  Ms. Samta Jain - learned Government Advocate for the State.
It is informed that death verification report in respect of applicant Suresh Kumar is received, who has been convicted under Section 420/34 of IPC and he expired on 23.05.2025.
Death certificate is verified by Police Station, Gopalganj.
Death verification report is taken on record.

As per ERP system, I.A. No. 28964 of 2025 is an application under Section 435 read with Section 442 of BNSS (Sec. 394 r/w 401of Cr.P.C.) for leave to continue the revision on behalf of Legal Representatives of deceased applicant.
Let the names of legal representatives be incorporated in the memo of revision within two weeks.
List on 6.4.2026 on top of the list.

(AVANINDRA KUMAR SINGH) JUDGE VSG 2 CRR-342-2000 Suresh Kumar vs The State Of M.P. on 5 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111871479/
